$why: The layout of an agent's standing instructions, in one place (lib/assistant-instructions.js renders it).
The role line comes FIRST — the seam's declared purpose — so the instructions never end on a stray
repeat of the assistant's description. `authored` is used once si-author has written them; `declared`
is the agent's recorded persona, used only where nothing has been authored (a seam run outside a
pipeline run, or the two authoring seams themselves, whose instructions are their canonical personas).
